app.name: Soup
app.one_liner: Fine-tune LLMs in one command with local execution, automated compliance, and supply-chain security.

screens.name: Main CLI Interface
screens.purpose: Provide unified entry point for all Soup commands including init, train, serve, adapters, attest, and env operations.

rust_commands.name: soup_adapters_sign
rust_commands.purpose: Cryptographically sign model adapters using ed25519 to ensure supply-chain integrity.

rust_commands.name: soup_attest_emit
rust_commands.purpose: Generate in-toto attestations with optional ed25519 signing for model provenance.

rust_commands.name: soup_env_fix
rust_commands.purpose: Render reproducible install plan from soup-env.lock without executing package manager.

rust_commands.name: soup_train
rust_commands.purpose: Execute end-to-end LLM fine-tuning with auto-configured QLoRA, energy tracking, and Annex XI compliance output.

mvp_plan: week 1: Add HIPAA/SOC2-style local audit logging
week 1: Generate Markdown Annex XI report with top domains
week 1: Implement core `soup train` command with QLoRA support
week 1: Integrate offline codecarbon energy tracker
week 2: Add PDF rendering for compliance reports
week 2: Build `soup attest` with in-toto statement emission
week 2: Implement ed25519 signing for adapters
week 2: Wire `soup env fix` from lockfile
acceptance_tests: Every invocation of `soup train` appends a structured audit log record to ~/.soup/audit.log in SOC2/HIPAA-compatible format.
Executing `soup env fix` outputs a reproducible uv pip install command block derived from soup-env.lock without side effects.
Running `soup train --track-energy --annex-xi report.pdf` produces a PDF containing EU AI Act Annex XI content with auto-extracted top domains and CO2/kWh metrics.
The command `soup adapters sign --backend ed25519 --key test.pem` generates a valid detached signature over the adapter Merkle root.
